inventive_nucleus: Implementing a motor mount with a tuned vibration damper reduces motor vibration and stress on the bearings, thereby increasing the lifespan of the bearings.

claim_versions.claim: A motor mount with a tuned vibration damper, wherein the tuned vibration damper is configured to interact with the motor and blower under high-speed operating conditions to reduce motor vibration and stress on bearings, thereby increasing the lifespan of the bearings by at least 30% and reducing motor vibration levels by at least 25%.

redesign.change: Added high-speed operating conditions and specified technical effect and distinguishing feature.
redesign.reason: This revised claim addresses the obviousness attack by incorporating a specific operating condition, which differentiates it from the prior art and provides a clear technical effect and distinguishing feature.

novelty_attack.reasoning: No reference provides all elements in the required arrangement, as each reference either discloses the motor mount with tuned vibration damper or the vibration reduction system, but not both.

obviousness_attack.motivation: A skilled person would combine the motor mount with tuned vibration damper from US 6,998,306 and the integrated vibration damping from EP 2,419,931 to reduce motor vibration and stress on the bearings.
obviousness_attack.reason_to_modify: The references provide a clear motivation to modify the motor mount with tuned vibration damper to include integrated vibration damping.
obviousness_attack.expectation_of_success: A skilled person would expect the combination to be successful in reducing motor vibration and stress on the bearings.
obviousness_attack.teaching_away: The references do not teach away from the combination, as they each provide a distinct solution to the problem of motor vibration.

design_around.easiest_workaround: Using a different type of vibration damper, such as a passive or active damper, that is not integrated into the motor mount.

attack.attack_reasoning: The combination of the motor mount with tuned vibration damper and integrated vibration damping is not novel, as it is obvious to a skilled person. The claim still covers a design around using a different type of vibration damper.

obviousness_attack.motivation: A skilled person would combine the motor mount with tuned vibration damper from US 6,124,244 and the technical effect of increasing the lifespan of bearings from EP 1,234,567 to achieve the claimed invention.
obviousness_attack.reason_to_modify: The combination of the motor mount with tuned vibration damper and the technical effect of increasing the lifespan of bearings would be a natural extension of the prior art, as it addresses a common problem in the field of motor mounts.
obviousness_attack.expectation_of_success: A skilled person would expect the combination to be successful, as the motor mount with tuned vibration damper is a well-established concept, and the technical effect of increasing the lifespan of bearings is a known benefit.
